en.topic_title: Hong Kong court acquits police officer of indecent assault charge after accuser’s testimony rejected
en.topic_summary:
A Hong Kong court has found a police officer not guilty of indecent assault after rejecting the testimony of his accuser.



Hong Kong Police Force. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP.



Officer Ng Ka‑wai pleaded not guilty when he appeared at the Kowloon City Magistrates’ Courts on Friday.
